kpis.description_fr: Commandes reçues FY24. Indicateur leading critique pour ABB (visibilité 6-12 mois). Demande forte électrification + data centers.
kpis.description_en: Order intake FY24. Critical leading indicator for ABB (6-12 month visibility). Strong electrification + data center demand.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Electrification FY24. Cœur croissance ABB (data centers, EV charging, infrastructure énergie). Marge >20%.
kpis.description_en: Electrification segment revenue FY24. Core ABB growth (data centers, EV charging, energy infrastructure). >20% margin.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Robotics & Discrete Automation FY24. Pression cycle court (auto, electronics). Cible 8000+ robots/an.
kpis.description_en: Robotics & Discrete Automation revenue FY24. Short-cycle pressure (auto, electronics). 8000+ robots/year target.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Process Automation (industries lourdes : mining, oil & gas, marine, pulp & paper) FY24. Demande forte modernisation.
kpis.description_en: Process Automation revenue (heavy industries: mining, oil & gas, marine, pulp & paper) FY24. Strong modernization demand.

kpis.description_fr: Marge EBITA opérationnelle FY24. Expansion continue, devrait dépasser 18% cible 2026 plus tôt. Pricing power + opex efficiency.
kpis.description_en: Operational EBITA margin FY24. Continued expansion, on track to exceed 18% 2026 target earlier. Pricing power + opex efficiency.

kpis_story.description_fr: ABB bénéficiaire majeur boom data centers AI 2024-2025 : équipements alimentation électrique HV/MV, UPS, refroidissement. Commandes data center +20%+ par an.
kpis_story.description_en: ABB major AI data center boom beneficiary 2024-2025: HV/MV power equipment, UPS, cooling systems. Data center orders +20%+ yearly.

_notes: ABBNY = ADR of ABB Ltd. Source: ABB AR FY24.
